architecture: ANS global/local hierarchy with OV-SDF, STGHP, RPN-UQ and IGCR interfaces
primary_metric: delta(covered_2d_area_m2 * global_3d_f1_at_5cm) from the shared prefix
secondary_metrics: new visible surface area and local recall
statistical_rule: report paired differences, wins/ties/losses, exact one-sided sign test and 95 percent context bootstrap; no threshold is changed after results
stress_rule: report all outcomes and fallback rates separately; stress results cannot be used to replace a failed efficacy gate
failure_policy: retain every failure; do not tune on F00-F11; a new method version requires a new future confirmation set
scope: independent programmatic confirmation of the artificial two-asset mechanism; not natural open-vocabulary, large-scale, mainstream-baseline or real-robot confirmation
